title: Theorem 1.1: a.s. recurrence of distributional limits of uniformly bounded-degree unbiased finite planar graphs
statement_scope: Let M<\infty, and let (G,o) be a distributional limit of rooted random unbiased finite planar graphs G_j with degrees bounded by M. Then with probability one G is recurrent.
